calibration.reference: DAMIT model 167 calibrated size, Ďurech et al. (2011), Icarus 214, 652
calibration.notes: DAMIT marks model 167 as size-calibrated (D = 38 km, σ = 5 km) and archives the 2005-12-13 occultation fit to this mesh. DAMIT labels the model 'preliminary'. NEOWISE lists 39.025 ± 0.462 km (Masiero et al. 2014), consistent within the quoted error.
calibration.sourceLabel: DAMIT model 167 calibrated size, Ďurech et al. (2011), Icarus 214, 652
calibration.limitations: Uniform scale of the unchanged archived mesh by the adopted diameter and its quoted uncertainty. DAMIT marks model 167 as size-calibrated (D = 38 km, σ = 5 km) and archives the 2005-12-13 occultation fit to this mesh. DAMIT labels the model 'preliminary'. NEOWISE lists 39.025 ± 0.462 km (Masiero et al. 2014), consistent within the quoted error.

modelLimitations: The convex inversion resolves the broad shape; craters and concavities are unresolved.
